title: Q-RES-chen-stratton-2026-F6: AI review tools leave humans in the loop (measured 0.203, target >= 0.5)
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** research pass: chen-stratton-2026 finding F6 is not-met (measured 0.203)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation research --probe chen-stratton-2026:F6
**Prediction:** system_authored_share >= 0.5 within 336 h
**Status:** open

Concern: AI review tools leave humans in the loop. The study: 79.1% of firms adopted AI code review tools, but the overwhelming majority of reviews and comments are still written by people, so the bottleneck persists.

Mechanisms that should answer it: CLOSED-LOOP-1 (foundation/closedloop.py); CRITICALITY-1 (foundation/criticality.py).

Metric: share of merged pull requests opened by the system itself, target >= 0.5. Improve the mechanism (or add one) until the probe passes; the white paper at /research updates itself from the same measurement.
